newsitem.title: CANADA: FOCUS - Canada seen keeping inflation low for years.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Canada seen keeping inflation low for years.

text.p: Canada is likely maintain one of the lowest inflation rates in the industrialized world for several years, with the currency and bonds benefitting as a result, analysts said on Tuesday.
"I'm bullish on inflation over the next few years here, and certainly relative to the U.S.," said Dan Kelly, a financial market analyst with CIBC Wood Gundy Securities. "Inflation is dead in Canada."
A government report released on Tuesday confirmed that inflation pressures remains subdued.
